name: board
description: Schedules beads stories on a Jira-style timeline, each with its own single-DAG pipeline (ideate through retro) that pauses for a human wherever a gate needs one - answer OPEN QUESTIONS, approve, or fix a break - and resumes correctly once they act. Configure projects via knowledge.beads_project_paths.
author: kirocrew
useCases: Schedule and reorder beads stories on a timeline, by week or by quarter, without leaving the dashboard.
Run a story's whole pipeline - ideate through retro - as one DAG, and see at a glance which stories need you (an answer, an approval, a fix) and which are just running.
